composition_strategy: Symmetrical Layout with Central Focal Point
positive_prompt: Create an elegant black-tie ballroom environment with refined architectural forms and formal drapery-inspired shapes, The composition should be symmetrical with layered depth and polished evening lighting, Include architectural columns and drapery motifs that are repeated in a structured and symmetrical manner, The background should be black and white, with tonal variation to enhance the sense of formality and sophistication, A strictly achromatic palette of black and white, with tonal variation inside those requested neutral colours, Visual subject: An elegant black-tie ballroom environment with refined architectural forms, layered depth, formal drapery-inspired shapes and polished evening lighting, Clarified visual language: motifs: refined architectural forms, formal drapery-inspired shapes, motif structure: Motifs should be repeated in a structured and symmetrical manner, reflecting the formality of the event, atmosphere: elegant, sophisticated, celebratory, composition: symmetrical, Original brief-specific composition, coherent visual hierarchy, intentional calm negative space, balanced depth and gentle tonal modelling, Theme references are represented through brief-grounded abstract geometry, patterns, spatial structure, atmosphere and colour relationships, Architecture, environment, materials, textures and lighting are used only when supported by the brief
negative_prompt: Avoid any unrelated generic imagery, crowded center, readable text, people, characters, bright and colorful elements, and casual or informal treatments., person, human, human figure, man, woman, child, face, portrait, silhouette, body, head, hands, arms, legs, clothing, mannequin, character, fictional character, hero, superhero, masked character, mascot, costume, costumed figure, humanoid, text, typography, lettering, words, letters, numbers, writing, calligraphy, signature, logo, watermark, signage, unrequested chromatic design colours, colour drift, unrelated hues, large neutral areas that displace the requested colours, unrelated generic imagery, crowded centre
short_design_rationale: This direction focuses on an elegant and sophisticated black-tie ballroom setting, emphasizing architectural and drapery motifs to convey formality and celebration. The symmetrical composition, layered depth, and polished lighting create a visually appealing and celebratory atmosphere.
